Author: Lun et al. (2019)
Approach_Description: Statistical difference of droplets from ambient profile used to call cells using Monte Carlo approach

Author: Yang et al. (2020)
Ambient_Basis: With empty droplets: Low total UMI count droplets; No empty droplets: Droplet cluster assignments
Approach_Description: Deconvolving cell and ambient counts using Bayesian variational inference
Benchmarking_Summary: Recommended for datasets without empty droplets and well-based datasets

Author: Heaton et al. (2020)
Additional_Requirements: Allele variants present in reads; Cell Ranger .bam file
Approach_Description: Maximum likelihood used to estimate ambient contamination using allele fractions

Author: Alvarez et al. (2020)
Approach_Description: Enrichment of ambient genes in clustered droplets determined using Expectation-Maximization algorithm

Author: Young and Behjati (2020)
Approach_Description: Maximum likelihood used to estimate contamination then subtract this from counts

Author: Heiser et al. (2021)
Approach_Description: Multilevel thresholding on number of detected genes per droplet then logistic regression used to call cells

Author: Muskovic and Powell (2021)
Ambient_Basis: UMI counts and unspliced read fractions per droplet (nuclear fraction)
Approach_Description: Empty droplets called using kernel density estimation; damaged cells called using Gaussian mixture model

Author: Sheng et al. (2022)
Technology_Suitability: Droplet-based single-cell omics; Droplet-based scRNA-seq; Droplet-based snRNA-seq; Droplet-based scCRISPR-seq; Droplet-based scATAC-seq; Droplet-based CITE-seq
Benchmarking_Summary: Not recommended due to artificial count inflation

Author: Xi et al. (2023)
Ambient_Basis: Identifies confident cells based on UMI counts
Approach_Description: Count matrix permutation and XGBoost algorithm used to call cells; cell and ambient counts modelled as multinomial mixtures and ambient contamination estimated using maximum likelihood

Author: Arceneaux et al. (2023)
Approach_Description: AUC and secant-based statistics computed and plotted using barcode ranks and cumulative transcript count distributions

Author: Fleming et al. (2023)
Technology_Suitability: Droplet-based scRNA-seq; Droplet-based snRNA-seq; Droplet-based CITE-seq
Benchmarking_Summary: Recommended for raw droplet datasets if strong compute resources present

Author: Berg et al. (2023)
Approach_Description: Subtraction of ambient gene counts from cell counts matrix if a gene's dropout rate in empty droplets exceeds user-specified allowable ambient fraction
Benchmarking_Summary: Made for single-cell DGE context but limited benchmarking suggests mediocre performance

Author: Wang et al. (2024)
Ambient_Basis: Genes with significantly large entropy divergence in most cell clusters
Approach_Description: Youden-index method used to compute contamination threshold of each selected gene then subtract this from all cells
Benchmarking_Summary: Similar use cases to DecontX but inferior performance

Author: Huang et al. (2025)
Ambient_Basis: Genes with largest distance between counts in empty droplets and predicted counts from cell clusters
Approach_Description: Uses non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF) and AUROC-based metrics to identify ambient seed genes and correct counts of these in sample-specific manner
Benchmarking_Summary: Not recommended due to artificial count inflation
Notes: Corrects selected genes only but affects entire count matrix due to NMF

Author: Li et al. (2025)
Approach_Description: Number of real allele variants that do not match assigned genotype of nucleus gives lower bound of ambient contamination present

Author: Schaefer et al. (2025)
Approach_Description: Variants that do not match known genotype of each droplet used to estimate ambient contamination; ambient counts subtracted to correct contamination
Other_Features: Demultiplexing; Doublet detection; Find donor proportions; Assign sgRRNAs to cells

Author: Alvarez et al. (2025)
Additional_Requirements: Allele variants present in reads; Genotypes; Peak/gene annotations
Technology_Suitability: Droplet-based scRNA-seq; Droplet-based scATAC-seq; Droplet-based scRNA+ATAC multiome
Approach_Description: Modelling cell and ambient counts based on variants in ambient pool using maximum likelihood; assigns ambient contamination estimation and cell/empty droplet status to each droplet
Other_Features: Demultiplexing; Doublet detection; Find donor proportions

Author: Caskey et al. (2026)
Technology_Suitability: Droplet-based scRNA-seq; Droplet-based scATAC-seq; Droplet-based snRNA-seq; Well-based scRNA-seq; Spatial transcriptomics
Ambient_Basis: With empty droplets: Low total UMI count droplets; No empty droplets: Cell type expression mixture
Approach_Description: Models and subtracts cell and ambient counts using Expectation-Maximization algorithm
